provenance.author: Larry Klosowski + Claude Opus 5.5
provenance.purpose: HUP-S3.5 Citrate QA eval set v1 (US-3.1 'it knows Citrate out of the box'): 150 hand-authored questions over ten categories with answer key points and citations (source repo + repo-relative path + heading anchor) into public Citrate material pinned by commit. About 10% are unanswerable probes whose right answer is that the topic is not documented. Scored deterministically by src/agent/eval/qa.ts: key-point coverage, citation validity against qa-v1.anchors.json, and abstention; no model-as-judge.
provenance.note: Planset 05 'Eval provenance': must stay disjoint from any E9 training trajectories; never copy into training data. Sources are public-tier only (citrate-docs, citrate-chain, agentile-skills); no private audit material. To change an item, make qa-v2; do not edit v1 in place. scripts/qa-anchors.mjs --check re-derives the anchor index and verifies every key point appears in its cited section.
